headline.title: Bomb hoaxes divert flights and empty a cruise ship
headline.quip: Nothing was found on any aircraft, which is the good news, and also exactly how a hoax works.
headline.summary: Hoax bomb threats hit at least seven flights, four of them Ryanair, plus Wizz Air, SAS and LOT, and a cruise ship. Warsaw Modlin airport closed, a runway closed at Warsaw Chopin, and Eurofighters escorted a Ryanair flight into Rome. About 1,500 people were evacuated from the cruise ship Crown Iris off Syros, Greece. Nothing was found.

also.title: A New York casino goes cash-only after a cyber incident
also.summary: Turning Stone casino in New York went cash-only after a cyber incident; ATMs were off, and bingo and sportsbooks closed there and at four affiliates.
